data: Write one config file and a folder of Markdown. You get a landing page, docs with ⌘K search, a changelog, a Markdown copy of every page for agents, and a one-command deploy to your own domain.
Three commands
From a tool’s folder to its own address.
Make the site from the tool’s repo, write the words, and publish. On your own domain, the deploy adds the DNS record and turns on HTTPS. This site was made the same way.
Quick start
/docs/quick-start

# make a site for a tool
scripts/new-site.sh mytool --from ~/Projects/mytool --domain example.com

# write site.config.ts and content/docs, then look
npm run dev

# publish, with DNS and HTTPS
scripts/deploy-pages.sh
One source
Write it once, get it five ways.
Each docs page is a Markdown file. The site renders it, adds it to the sidebar and search, serves it as .md, and lists it in llms.txt. Nothing to keep in step by hand.
Writing docs
/docs/writing-docs
page
The docs page, with heading links and copy buttons
sidebar
Grouped from front matter, ordered by file name
⌘K
Search over every section, built at build time
.md
The same page as Markdown, for agents
llms.txt
An index of every page, plus llms-full.txt
Your colours
Two numbers set the look.

Pick a hue for the greys and a hue for the accent. Light and dark palettes, shadows, selection, focus and the favicon all follow. Type, spacing and motion come from the build-craft rules and stay the same across your tools.
Configuration
/docs/configuration
colours: { tint: 255, accent: 75 },
Agents
An agent can build the site for you.
The template ships an AGENTS.md that says where everything goes and what good copy looks like. Point a coding agent at your tool and the new site folder and it fills in both.
Read this, agents
/docs/agents
What does it cost?
Nothing. It builds to static files, and GitHub Pages hosts them for free on a public repo.
Can I use my own domain?
Yes. Set origin and deploy. If your DNS is on Cloudflare, the deploy adds the record for you. See Deploying.
What if a tool needs a custom demo?
Put it in src/custom/Hero.svelte and it replaces the hero sample. Template updates leave it alone. See Custom hero and styles.
Can my agent read these docs?
Yes. Add .md to any docs URL, or start at llms.txt.
